Bug_Title: IM: Integer multiply of result of integer remainder (IM_MULTIPLYING_RESULT_OF_IREM)
Bug_Details:
The code multiplies the result of an integer remaining by an integer constant.
Be sure you don't have your operator precedence confused. For example
i % 60 * 1000 is (i % 60) * 1000, not i % (60 * 1000).
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line'return i % 60 * 1000;' where the expression is interpreted as (i % 60) * 1000 instead of i % (60 * 1000). This can lead to incorrect calculations if the intention was to take the remainder of i divided by 60000.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases call the showBug method with different inputs (12345, 0, -12345). Each test case compares the actual result returned by the method with the expected result if the bug were not present. Since the bug causes the method to incorrectly compute the result as (i % 60) * 1000 instead of i % (60 * 1000), the assertions fail, thereby triggering the bug.
